description: Source code for a Zephyr display driver for the HX8394 LCD panel, including configuration, initialization, and control functions.

methods.name: hx8394_init
methods.description: Initializes the HX8394 display panel, configures MIPI DSI interface, resets panel, and sends initialization commands.

methods.name: hx8394_blanking_on
methods.description: Turns the display off by controlling the backlight GPIO.

methods.name: hx8394_blanking_off
methods.description: Turns the display on by controlling the backlight GPIO.

methods.name: hx8394_write
methods.description: Placeholder function for writing to the display; not supported in this driver.

methods.name: hx8394_get_capabilities
methods.description: Retrieves display capabilities such as resolution and supported pixel formats.

methods.name: hx8394_set_pixel_format
methods.description: Sets the pixel format; not implemented, only logs warning.

methods.name: hx8394_set_orientation
methods.description: Sets display orientation by flipping scan direction via MIPI DSI commands.
